card.name: Preparation verbs in step sequences
card.fires_on: Practical action verbs such as built, prepare, dry, label, or the word and or ready, in instructions and build or assembly descriptions. They often come right after 'and' in a paired action.

modes.label: Second verb after and
modes.description: The second verb in a pair of actions joined by and, such as wash and dry or designed and built.

modes.label: Step-opening verb
modes.description: A verb that starts a numbered or bulleted instruction step, such as Label the syringe.
modes.example: 4.<< Label>> syringe a. Label the syringe

modes.label: Finished or readied state
modes.description: A word marking something as completed or made ready.

card.plain: It fires on hands-on action verbs in how-to steps and build descriptions, especially the second verb after 'and'.
